title: D-Wave Advantage2 量子退火器
summary: 以QUBO、Zephyr 圖嵌入與端到端公平比較解析D-Wave Advantage2 量子退火器：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore D-Wave Advantage2 quantum annealer through qubo, zephyr embeddings and fair end-to-end comparison: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 依公開研究與裝置資料編寫的離線模型、編譯及證據判讀。不是實機組裝、雷射或低溫作業SOP；假想算例不代表廠商精度、量子優勢或容錯能力。研發宣稱與已驗證觀測分開標示。
scopeEn: Offline models, compilation and evidence interpretation from public research/device sources. Not hardware assembly, laser/cryogenic SOPs; assumed examples are not vendor fidelity, advantage or fault tolerance. Development claims and demonstrated observations remain distinct.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在D-Wave Advantage2 量子退火器案例中比較QUBO與Ising符號與Zephyr物理圖，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate qubo and ising signs and zephyr physical graph within the D-Wave Advantage2 quantum annealer case.

steps.title: Ising 與 QUBO 對映：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Ising and QUBO mapping: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對QUBO與Ising符號提出可反駁的Ising 與 QUBO 對映模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable ising and qubo mapping model and evidence record for qubo and ising signs.
steps.instruction: 在「D-Wave Advantage2 量子退火器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識QUBO與Ising符號。二元優化可用成本函數表示；轉成自旋變量時常數、符號與尺度需一致。 建立Ising 與 QUBO 對映的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QUBO、Zephyr 圖嵌入與端到端公平比較。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。窮舉小題並核對 QUBO 與 Ising 的相同最小解。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify qubo and ising signs in the mentor diagram and primary sources for D-Wave Advantage2 quantum annealer. Binary optimization maps to costs; spin conversion must retain constants, signs and scaling. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ising and qubo mapping, focusing on qubo, zephyr embeddings and fair end-to-end comparison. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Enumerate a small problem and verify equal QUBO/Ising minima. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 窮舉小題並核對 QUBO 與 Ising 的相同最小解。
steps.observationEn: Enumerate a small problem and verify equal QUBO/Ising minima.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：任意 QUBO 符號翻轉都保留原目標。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Any QUBO sign flip preserves the original objective.
steps.check: 提交QUBO與Ising符號的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for qubo and ising signs.

knowledge.title: Ising 與 QUBO 對映
knowledge.text: 二元優化可用成本函數表示；轉成自旋變量時常數、符號與尺度需一致。 本課架構對應：QUBO與Ising符號
knowledge.textEn: Binary optimization maps to costs; spin conversion must retain constants, signs and scaling. Course architecture correspondence: QUBO and Ising signs

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 窮舉小題並核對 QUBO 與 Ising 的相同最小解。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；任意 QUBO 符號翻轉都保留原目標。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Enumerate a small problem and verify equal QUBO/Ising minima. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Any QUBO sign flip preserves the original objective.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設二元目標 E(x1,x2)=2x1+2x2−3x1x2，四組成本依(00,01,10,11)為(0,2,2,1)，最小解00。以 x=(s+1)/2 重算等價 Ising，再比較常數偏移與最小解。這不是量子優勢證據。
knowledge.textEn: For assumed E=2x1+2x2−3x1x2, (00,01,10,11) cost (0,2,2,1), minimum 00. Convert using x=(s+1)/2 and check constants/minima. This is not evidence of quantum advantage.

quiz.question: 就QUBO與Ising符號的「Ising 與 QUBO 對映」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for ising and qubo mapping in qubo and ising signs?
options: 二元優化可用成本函數表示；轉成自旋變量時常數、符號與尺度需一致。
任意 QUBO 符號翻轉都保留原目標。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Binary optimization maps to costs; spin conversion must retain constants, signs and scaling.
Any QUBO sign flip preserves the original objective.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 二元優化可用成本函數表示；轉成自旋變量時常數、符號與尺度需一致。 窮舉小題並核對 QUBO 與 Ising 的相同最小解。
quiz.explanationEn: Binary optimization maps to costs; spin conversion must retain constants, signs and scaling. Enumerate a small problem and verify equal QUBO/Ising minima.

steps.title: Ising 與 QUBO 對映：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Ising and QUBO mapping: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對QUBO與Ising符號提出可反駁的Ising 與 QUBO 對映模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable ising and qubo mapping model and evidence record for qubo and ising signs.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「Ising 與 QUBO 對映」模型，檢查QUBO與Ising符號的兩個假想案例。窮舉小題並核對 QUBO 與 Ising 的相同最小解。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分二元優化可用成本函數表示；轉成自旋變量時常數、符號與尺度需一致。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous ising and qubo mapping model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving qubo and ising signs. Enumerate a small problem and verify equal QUBO/Ising minima. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Binary optimization maps to costs; spin conversion must retain constants, signs and scaling." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 窮舉小題並核對 QUBO 與 Ising 的相同最小解。
steps.observationEn: Enumerate a small problem and verify equal QUBO/Ising minima.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：任意 QUBO 符號翻轉都保留原目標。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Any QUBO sign flip preserves the original objective.
steps.check: 提交QUBO與Ising符號的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for qubo and ising signs.

options: 任意 QUBO 符號翻轉都保留原目標。

steps.title: 稀疏耦合與嵌入：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Sparse connectivity and embedding: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Zephyr物理圖提出可反駁的稀疏耦合與嵌入模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable sparse connectivity and embedding model and evidence record for zephyr physical graph.
steps.instruction: 在「D-Wave Advantage2 量子退火器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Zephyr物理圖。邏輯圖可透過鏈嵌入物理圖；更高連通通常減少部分鏈成本而非消除全部代價。 建立稀疏耦合與嵌入的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QUBO、Zephyr 圖嵌入與端到端公平比較。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較同一小圖在兩種拓撲的鏈數與長度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify zephyr physical graph in the mentor diagram and primary sources for D-Wave Advantage2 quantum annealer. Chains embed logical graphs into hardware; higher connectivity can reduce some chain costs, not eliminate them. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of sparse connectivity and embedding, focusing on qubo, zephyr embeddings and fair end-to-end comparison. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare chain counts/lengths for one graph on two topologies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較同一小圖在兩種拓撲的鏈數與長度。
steps.observationEn: Compare chain counts/lengths for one graph on two topologies.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：物理位元數等於可直接處理的任意邏輯變數數。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Physical qubit count equals directly solvable arbitrary logical variables.
steps.check: 提交Zephyr物理圖的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for zephyr physical graph.

knowledge.title: 稀疏耦合與嵌入
knowledge.text: 邏輯圖可透過鏈嵌入物理圖；更高連通通常減少部分鏈成本而非消除全部代價。 本課架構對應：Zephyr物理圖
knowledge.textEn: Chains embed logical graphs into hardware; higher connectivity can reduce some chain costs, not eliminate them. Course architecture correspondence: Zephyr physical graph

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較同一小圖在兩種拓撲的鏈數與長度。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；物理位元數等於可直接處理的任意邏輯變數數。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare chain counts/lengths for one graph on two topologies. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Physical qubit count equals directly solvable arbitrary logical variables.

quiz.question: 就Zephyr物理圖的「稀疏耦合與嵌入」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for sparse connectivity and embedding in zephyr physical graph?
options: 物理位元數等於可直接處理的任意邏輯變數數。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
邏輯圖可透過鏈嵌入物理圖；更高連通通常減少部分鏈成本而非消除全部代價。
optionsEn: Physical qubit count equals directly solvable arbitrary logical variables.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Chains embed logical graphs into hardware; higher connectivity can reduce some chain costs, not eliminate them.
quiz.explanation: 邏輯圖可透過鏈嵌入物理圖；更高連通通常減少部分鏈成本而非消除全部代價。 比較同一小圖在兩種拓撲的鏈數與長度。
quiz.explanationEn: Chains embed logical graphs into hardware; higher connectivity can reduce some chain costs, not eliminate them. Compare chain counts/lengths for one graph on two topologies.

steps.title: 稀疏耦合與嵌入：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Sparse connectivity and embedding: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對Zephyr物理圖提出可反駁的稀疏耦合與嵌入模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable sparse connectivity and embedding model and evidence record for zephyr physical graph.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「稀疏耦合與嵌入」模型，檢查Zephyr物理圖的兩個假想案例。比較同一小圖在兩種拓撲的鏈數與長度。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分邏輯圖可透過鏈嵌入物理圖；更高連通通常減少部分鏈成本而非消除全部代價。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous sparse connectivity and embedding model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving zephyr physical graph. Compare chain counts/lengths for one graph on two topologies. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Chains embed logical graphs into hardware; higher connectivity can reduce some chain costs, not eliminate them." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較同一小圖在兩種拓撲的鏈數與長度。
steps.observationEn: Compare chain counts/lengths for one graph on two topologies.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：物理位元數等於可直接處理的任意邏輯變數數。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Physical qubit count equals directly solvable arbitrary logical variables.
steps.check: 提交Zephyr物理圖的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for zephyr physical graph.
